summary: {person} proposes an inflation adjustment for nonprofit partners delivering county services.
realLife: Montgomery County’s FY25 executive proposal included an increase for every nonprofit partner to account for inflation.
inGame: needs: price adjustments by county contract.

turns.what: The county renews contracts at their existing rates.
turns.pulledBy: The adopted budget has no inflation allowance.
turns.writesBack: The renewal lists the prior rate.

turns.what: Only contracts up for renewal get the adjustment.
turns.pulledBy: Other agreements lock in their rates for another year.
turns.writesBack: The contract register shows which providers qualify.
